import json
train = set()

import json, hashlib

def hash_conversations(filepath):
    hashes = {}
    with open(filepath) as f:
        for line in f:
            d = json.loads(line)
            # hash the full conversation content
            turns = d.get('turns', d.get('conversation', []))
            content = json.dumps(turns, sort_keys=True)
            h = hashlib.md5(content.encode()).hexdigest()
            cid = d.get('conversation_id', d.get('id', ''))
            hashes[h] = cid
    return hashes

train_h = hash_conversations('data/mixed_llm/train.jsonl')
test_h = hash_conversations('data/mixed_llm/test.jsonl')
val_h = hash_conversations('data/mixed_llm/val.jsonl')

content_overlap_tv = set(train_h.keys()) & set(val_h.keys())

print(f'Test unique contents: {len(test_h)}')

print(f'Content overlap train-val: {len(content_overlap_tv)}')

import json
from collections import Counter

            n += 1
    print(f'{split}: n={n}, labels={dict(labels)}, sources={dict(sources)}')
"

```bash
# 看 9-class training log
find logs/ -name "*9class*" -o -name "*exp16*" | head -10
# 检查包含 loss 信息的 log
grep -r "loss" logs/exp16_9class_train.log 2>/dev/null | tail -20
# 或搜索其他可能的 log 位置
find . -name "*.log" -newer checkpoints/exp16/ | head -10
```

1. conversation_id 级别泄漏: 有/无

3. label/source 分布
4. train loss 曲线是否真的降到 0（如果是，可能是过拟合而非泄漏）
